'''Honey Island''' (Japanese: '''ハニー島''' ''Honey Island'') is the first island {{Ash}}, {{an|Iris}}, and {{an|Cilan}} visited during their travels through the [[Decolore Islands]]. It is well known for the sweet [[Honey]] that some of the Pokémon here produce.

In ''[[BW124|Danger, Sweet as Honey!]]'', on the island, Ash got invited to partake in an All-You-Can-Eat lottery, which turned out to be a scam of {{TRT}}. The lottery was an actual trap in an attempt for them to catch {{AP|Pikachu}}, and Ash and {{ashfr}} got taken to the fields of the island and fell into one of Team Rocket's pits. They got out, and before Team Rocket could get away with Pikachu, a swarm of {{p|Kakuna}} [[Evolution|evolved]] into {{p|Beedrill}}, which caused the groups to get split into three. After finding each other, Ash and his friends managed to reach the [[Pokémon Center]] located on the island and enjoyed the island's famous honey.

It also briefly appeared at the beginning of ''[[BW125|Cilan and the Case of the Purrloin Witness!]]''. Ash, Iris, and Cilan boarded a new boat at the harbor, as they had missed the previous boat that left Honey Island.
